message.content:
Here is a demonstration of mathematical typesetting in Markdown:

### 1. Inline Math
The quadratic formula $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$ gives the roots of a quadratic equation $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$.

### 2. Display Math with Aligned Equations
$$\begin{align}
x + y &= 5 \\
2x - y &= 1
\end{align}$$

### 3. Matrices and Piecewise Functions
$$I = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, \quad
f(x) = \begin{cases}
x^2 & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\
-x & \text{if } x < 0
\end{cases}$$

### 4. Multiple Display Equations
$$E = mc^2$$
$$F = ma$$
$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

### 5. Links
See [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_formula) for more details on the quadratic formula.

### 6. Money Context (Should Not Render as Math)
The item costs \$5 and the shipping is \$10, for a total of \$15. Budget: \$1000.
